ios.desc:
Struggling to wake up in the morning?

Unsnooze is the alarm clock you can't switch off until you're actually awake. To stop it, you have to complete a series of physical or mental challenges.

No more endless snoozing. No more oversleeping.

WAKE UP WITH A CHALLENGE

Pick from 15+  wake-up challenges, from push-ups and squats counted by your camera to math problems, memory games, and a scavenger hunt where you find an object around your home. Chain a few together, or let Unsnooze surprise you with a different one each morning.

By the time you've finished, your mind and body are fully awake.

AN ALARM THAT WON'T GIVE UP

Unsnooze rings just like the built-in Clock app: on the lock screen, through Silent mode and Focus. If you dismiss it or quit halfway, it rings again. Choose from 30+ loud alarm tones, wake up to your own music, or record a message to your sleepy self about why getting up matters.

Snooze is there if you want it, but only on your terms. You decide how long and how many times.

BUILD A STREAK

Every morning you finish your challenge adds to your wake-up streak. Track it on a calendar, earn achievements, and see how your wake-up times and habits improve. Miss a day? A streak freeze can save it, and an evening reminder warns you when your streak is about to break.

Want to try a challenge without setting an alarm? Practice any of them anytime. Practice never counts toward your streak.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE

Heavy sleepers who ignore normal alarms, students with early classes, athletes and early risers, and anyone who wants more discipline and better mornings. Available in English, Spanish, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

Stop snoozing. Start waking up with purpose.

SUBSCRIPTION

Unsnooze requires a subscription after a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdEULA/
